# Metrics

- [m-events] Telemetry platform handling 8B+ events per week.
- [m-lake] Data lake of 120TB+.
- [m-pipelines] Migrated 1,200+ legacy pipelines into a source-controlled
  monorepo.
- [m-facilities] Quality measures reported across 14 facilities.
- [m-analytics-pipeline] Weekly analytics pipeline covering 90M+ rows for 30k
  members.
- [m-analysts] Shared helpers used by 9 analysts.
- [m-onboarding] First six months of a new role.
- [m-reconciliation] Automated a manual reconciliation that had taken two days
  each month.
